verses.raw: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves,<sup foot_note=255967>1</sup> and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book<sup foot_note=255968>2</sup> inscribed.
